title: Developer control testing and verifiable flaw correction need reviewed release evidence
remediation: The sponsor assessment lead and developer assurance lead approve the post-design assessment plan, test methods, scope and frequency for security and privacy controls. Retain evidence of test execution and the reviewed result. Trace a flaw through triage, correction and exact-version retest with acceptance or disposition of unresolved findings. Use G6 for scoped static analysis.

milestones.title: Collect the approved assessment plan, a versioned execution report, and a finding traced through fix and retest
